purpose: Tagger tags assigned to the cards/illustrations of fixtures/scryfall/reversible-card.json, plus the full parent chain of each tag.
selector: oracle_tags: taggings[].oracle_id ∈ fixture oracle ids; art_tags: taggings[].illustration_id ∈ fixture illustration ids. Per target, tags sorted by (tagging has annotation / non-median weight first, tag has parents first, slug) and capped at 15 oracle / 10 art tags. Ancestors = transitive closure over parent_ids. taggings[] filtered to the fixture targets. Available per target: 61fbaaf2…: 6 oracle tags; b0b6be0c…: 6 oracle tags; 6b8fb6bb…: 8 art tags; 8642d280…: 6 art tags; b486d3c5…: 14 art tags; c3204342…: 10 art tags; de505901…: 13 art tags; faebc2ac…: 11 art tags.
note: Tag records are the original Tagger objects except: (1) taggings[] is FILTERED (see selector) and the fixture-added key `taggingsTotal` gives the unfiltered count; (2) child_ids[] is filtered to tags present in this file and the fixture-added key `childIdsTotal` gives the unfiltered count. parent_ids[] is complete: every ancestor is included, so the file is a closed sub-hierarchy in which child_ids is still the exact inverse of parent_ids. `taggingsTotal` and `childIdsTotal` are NOT source fields.

records.label: alliteration
records.description: Cards that alliterate, either properly or per Treacherous Trapezist.

records.label: namesake spell
records.description: Spells (or, mostly spells) with names that identify them with a specific named character.

records.label: token replacer
records.description: Cards that completely replace the tokens that will be created with other tokens.

records.label: unique mana cost
records.description: This card's mana cost isn't found on any other card.

records.label: discount-self
records.description: Cards that have a way to reduce their own cost

records.label: power matters-total
records.description: Effects which care about the total power of some set of creatures.

records.label: scales with power
records.description: Effects which scale with the power of one or more creatures.

records.label: virtual french vanilla
records.description: Creatures and vehicles that are french vanilla (having only keyword abilities) after entering the battlefield. They may have "enters the battlefield" or "on cast" trigger.

records.label: face-commander
records.description: A card that is the primary, marquee legendary creature featured on the packaging of a pre-constructed Commander deck. It sets the main mechanical theme and color identity of the deck.

records.label: hat
records.description: Clothing worn on the head.

records.label: artist signature
records.description: The artist's personal mark, identifying the work as their own. (Artist signatures might be cropped out in some versions of the same art.)

records.label: english text
records.description: Text appearing inside card art that's legible English or its alphabet.

records.label: neutral background
records.description: A flat color or gradient background with no details.

records.label: fang
records.description: Sharp pointed teeth

records.label: planeswalker symbol
records.description: The planeswalker symbol in art. Don't use this for the planeswalker stamp.

records.label: loose lips
records.description: Depicts a subject with an open mouth (see Knight of the Kitchen Sink)

records.label: ixalan (continent)
records.description: A continent on the plane of Ixalan.

records.label: larger than landscape
records.description: A subject's immense size is demonstrated by comparison to the landscape around it.

records.label: oversized creature
records.description: Creatures much greater than their usual scale.

records.label: solo
records.description: Only one figure is present in these artworks.

records.label: good boy
records.description: Friendly/Trustworthy looking dogs.

records.label: indoor
records.description: Objects, scenes, characters and events that are or occur indoors, and not outside.

records.label: art media
records.description: Media used to render the artwork.

records.label: character
records.description: Named characters.

records.label: clothing
records.description: Tags describing varieties of clothing.

records.label: elf
records.description: 🧝🧝‍♂️🧝‍♀️The various elves that have appeared in Magic

records.label: for scale

records.label: glyph

records.label: humanoid

records.label: meta imagery
records.description: Magic depicting Magic

records.label: planar origin
records.description: Tags classifying the origins of creatures and objects from across the multiverse.

records.label: plane
records.description: A collection of art tags that relate to specific planes.

records.label: pose
records.description: Tags describing someone's pose.

records.label: written language

records.label: card names
records.description: A collection of tags identifying properties and naming schemes in cards.

records.label: cheaper than mv
records.description: The actual cost you pay for an effect (or for an alternate mode) will often be lower than the card's mana value.

records.label: cycle

records.label: flavors of vanilla
